documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported solid financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, posting an operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs and an EBITDA of Rs. 46,710.23 Lakhs with a robust EBITDA margin of 29%. The company expanded its medical infrastructure and technology footprint during the year, highlighted by the inauguration of the Rs. 120 Crore Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block and ongoing investments in advanced diagnostics and treatment systems.

demand_outlook.claim: The hospital's performance was driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that global healthcare demand continues to rise, driven by aging populations, rapid medical technology advancements, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college has experienced significant growth with high demand for admissions, resulting in all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of Rs. 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai where the OP block will be ready for operation by the year end.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai. The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a significant investment of 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounted to 5239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the financial year was 15%.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and has expanded capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
orders_capacity.quote: In line with this concept, your company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind-generated power, covering nearly 68% of the annual power requirement. This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill. Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of Rs. 15 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.
The proposed dividend of 10/- per share for the financial year 2024-25 involves a cash outflow of 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100 %) for the Financial Year 2024-25 for approval of the members. The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company committed 357.69 Lakhs towards CSR activities during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review in pursuance of the recommendations of the CSR Committee, the Company had commitment of ₹ 357.69 Lakhs being 2% of the last three years’ average net profit of the Company towards implementing the CSR activities.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 10 per share for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100%) for the Financial Year 2023-24 for approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payout involves a cash outflow of 1094.23 lakhs if approved by members.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ` 1094.23 lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and uninterrupted operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: Construction work for the 300-bed paediatric hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: The outpatient block of the Chennai hospital will be ready for operation by this year end.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in the region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
management_commitments.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The management is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within the region.
management_commitments.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
